              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0 }
              - type: custom:lcards-button
                preset: toggle-tab
                entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights
                text: { name: { content: LIGHTS } }
                tap_action: { action: toggle }
              - type: custom:lcards-button
                preset: toggle-tab
                entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors
                text: { name: { content: DOORS } }
                tap_action: { action: toggle }

Picard: portrait panel ​

For a phone or an upright tablet: a header bar with the title, code blocks beside a condition readout, a tile wall, a gauge bank, toggle tabs and a segmented closing bar. Recorded at 600 by 1000.

YAML
yaml
# Picard portrait: the "portrait panel" archetype from doc/getting-started/lcars-design.md,
# for a phone or an upright wall tablet. A header bar with the title, a condition readout
# beside a column of code blocks, a tile wall, a gauge bank, toggle tabs and a segmented
# closing bar. Every colour is a theme role. Uses lcards_test_* helpers.
title: Picard Portrait
views:
  - title: Portrait
    path: portrait
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 10px
      grid-gap: 8px
      grid-template-columns: 120px minmax(0, 1fr)
      grid-template-rows: 56px 150px 120px minmax(0, 1fr) 52px 40px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "title  title"
        "codes  status"
        "tiles  tiles"
        "gauges gauges"
        "tabs   tabs"
        "foot   foot"
    cards:
      # Header bar with the title.
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        view_layout:
          grid-area: title
        preset: bar-label-left
        text:
          label:
            content: MISSION OPS
            color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary
        style:
          card:
            color:
              background:
                default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary

      # Code blocks, two of them tied to helpers.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: codes
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-rows: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: 07-82, position: center-right } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights
            text: { label: { content: 75-15, position: center-right } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: 7-385, position: center-right } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors
            text: { label: { content: 19-587, position: center-right } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }

      # Condition readout.
      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        view_layout:
          grid-area: status
        data_mode: data
        rows:
          - values: [CONDITION, "{{ 'NORMAL' if states('input_number.lcards_test_shields') | int > 30 else 'ALERT' }}"]
          - [POWER, "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_power') | int }} %"]
          - [SHIELDS, "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_shields') | int }} %"]
        grid:
          grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr
          grid-template-rows: repeat(3, min-content)
          gap: 6px
        style:
          font_size: 20px
        columns:
          - style:
              align: left
              color: theme:colors.ui.primary
          - style:
              align: right
              color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary

      # Tile wall.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: tiles
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
          grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr)
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-elbow
            elbow:
              type: frame
              segment: { color: theme:colors.card.topColor }
              frame: { bar_width: 3, bar_height: 3, outer_curve: 8 }
            symbiont:
              enabled: true
              position: { top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 }
              imprint: { enabled: false }
              card:
                type: custom:lcards-data-grid
                data_mode: decorative
                format: digit
                grid:
                  grid-template-rows: repeat(3, auto)
                  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
          - type: custom:lcards-elbow
            elbow:
              type: frame
              segment: { color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary }
              frame: { bar_width: 3, bar_height: 3, outer_curve: 8 }
            symbiont:
              enabled: true
              position: { top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 }
              imprint: { enabled: false }
              card:
                type: custom:lcards-data-grid
                data_mode: decorative
                format: hex
                grid:
                  grid-template-rows: repeat(3, auto)
                  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
          - type: custom:lcards-elbow
            elbow:
              type: frame
              segment: { color: theme:colors.card.topColor }
              frame: { bar_width: 3, bar_height: 3, outer_curve: 8 }
            symbiont:
              enabled: true
              position: { top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 }
              imprint: { enabled: false }
              card:
                type: custom:lcards-data-grid
                data_mode: decorative
                format: float
                grid:
                  grid-template-rows: repeat(3, auto)
                  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))

      # Gauge bank.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: gauges
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
          grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr)
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-slider, component: picard, preset: picard-gauge-vertical, entity: input_number.lcards_test_power }
          - { type: custom:lcards-slider, component: picard, preset: picard-gauge-vertical, entity: input_number.lcards_test_shields }
          - { type: custom:lcards-slider, component: picard, preset: picard-gauge-vertical, entity: input_number.lcards_test_humidity }

      # Toggle tabs.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: tabs
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
          grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr)
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: toggle-tab
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights
            text: { name: { content: LIGHTS } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: toggle-tab
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors
            text: { name: { content: DOORS } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: toggle-tab
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_toggle
            text: { name: { content: AUX } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }

      # A segmented bar closes the panel (no sweep: nothing below for it to turn into).
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: foot
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: 120px 3fr 1fr 2fr
          grid-template-rows: 16px
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 16, text: { label: { content: "", show: false } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 16, text: { label: { content: "453899-23780", position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 16, text: { label: { content: "692", position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 16, text: { label: { content: "4301-795-418", position: center-right } } }

Classic: sweep console ​

The classic look: thick header and footer sweeps continued as labelled segments, a sidebar of coloured blocks with code numbers, a pill grid led by big numbers, a slider over a strip of small pills, and a number cascade. The view sets theme: LCARS Default, so the roles come out in the TNG pastels whatever your profile theme is.

YAML
yaml
# TNG console: the classic look from the patterns in doc/getting-started/lcars-design.md.
# Thick colour blocks as structure: header and footer sweeps continued as labelled
# segments, a sidebar of blocks with code numbers, a pill grid led by big numbers in
# alternating roles, a slider and a strip of small pills, a number cascade. Every colour
# is a theme role, and the view uses the LCARS Default theme, so the roles come out in
# the classic pastels. Uses lcards_test_* helpers.
title: TNG Console
views:
  - title: Operations
    path: operations
    theme: LCARS Default
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 6px
      grid-template-columns: 170px 110px minmax(0, 3fr) minmax(0, 2fr)
      grid-template-rows: 56px 64px minmax(0, 1fr) 150px 70px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "corner corner bar    bar"
        "corner corner title  title"
        "side   pills  pills  readout"
        "side   status status readout"
        "fcorner fcorner fbar fbar"
    cards:
      # Header: a short thick sweep, the bar continued as labelled segments in several roles.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: corner
        elbow:
          type: header-left
          segment:
            bar_width: 170
            bar_height: 56
            color: theme:colors.ui.primary
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: bar
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: 3fr 1fr 4fr 2fr 2fr
          grid-template-rows: 56px
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 56, text: { label: { content: "COURSE SELECT", position: bottom-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 56, text: { label: { content: "541", position: bottom-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 56, text: { label: { content: "NAVIGATIONAL REFERENCE", position: bottom-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 56, text: { label: { content: "FLIGHT CONTROL", position: bottom-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 56, text: { label: { content: "47-2201", position: bottom-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } } }
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        view_layout:
          grid-area: title
        preset: text-only
        min_height: 0
        text:
          label:
            content: OPERATIONS • 40272
            show: true
            position: center-right
            font_size: 34
            color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary

      # Sidebar of blocks with code numbers, in different roles.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: side
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-rows: 2fr 1fr 1fr 3fr 1fr
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: 01-23564 } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: 02-24156 } }
            style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: 03-41248 } }
            style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: 04-14702 } }
            style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: 05-32456 } }

      # Pill grid: each row led by a big number, groups in alternating roles.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: pills
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: 90px repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
          grid-template-rows: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr))
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: "20", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 40, color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: lozenge
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights
            text: { label: { content: LIGHTS, show: true } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: AF 1137, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: NK 0042, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: "008", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 40, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: lozenge
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors
            text: { label: { content: DOORS, show: true } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: LK 7351, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: GH 8812, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: "72", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 40, color: theme:colors.ui.primary } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: lozenge
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_toggle
            text: { label: { content: SHIELDS, show: true } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: SE 9104, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: BE 3320, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: "358", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 40, color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: LE 4471, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: FW 6620, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: VD 1998, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: "451", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 40, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: HU 2045, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: MA 5531, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: AN 7764, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }

      # Readout: a number cascade.
      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        view_layout:
          grid-area: readout
        data_mode: decorative
        format: mixed
        grid:
          grid-template-rows: repeat(10, auto)
          grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr))
          gap: 0px
        style:
          padding: 0px
          font_size: 20px
        animations:
          - trigger: on_load
            preset: cascade-color

      # Under the pills: the power slider, then a strip of small pills (TNG panel strips).
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: status
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr))
          grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) 40px
          grid-template-areas: |
            "slider slider slider slider slider slider"
            "p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 p6"
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-slider
            view_layout: { grid-area: slider }
            entity: input_number.lcards_test_power
            preset: pills-basic
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 0, view_layout: { grid-area: p1 }, text: { label: { content: "GS IRC", show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 0, view_layout: { grid-area: p2 }, text: { label: { content: "KK TFD", show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 0, view_layout: { grid-area: p3 }, text: { label: { content: "LA TWE", show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 0, view_layout: { grid-area: p4 }, text: { label: { content: "BR TAS", show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 0, view_layout: { grid-area: p5 }, text: { label: { content: "IF WSD", show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 0, view_layout: { grid-area: p6 }, text: { label: { content: "LO PRC", show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }

      # Footer: a short sweep, the bottom bar continued as segments.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: fcorner
        elbow:
          type: footer-left
          segment:
            bar_width: 170
            bar_height: 30
            color: theme:colors.ui.primary
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: fbar
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: 2fr 5fr 1fr 2fr
          grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) 30px
          grid-template-areas: |
            ". . . sub"
            "s1 s2 s3 s4"
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            view_layout: { grid-area: sub }
            preset: text-only
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: LCARS 23295, show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 20, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 30, view_layout: { grid-area: s1 }, text: { label: { content: "PRIMARY CONTROL", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 30, view_layout: { grid-area: s2 }, text: { label: { content: "AUXILIARY CONTROL", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 30, view_layout: { grid-area: s3 }, text: { label: { content: "08", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 30, view_layout: { grid-area: s4 }, text: { label: { content: "4301-795", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }

Classic: bracket screen ​

DS9-style: top and bottom bars broken into labelled segments, a sidebar of coloured blocks with code numbers, a shuttlecraft cutaway in colour, a readout list and a row of pills. The view uses theme: LCARS Zeldaar.

YAML
yaml
# DS9 bracket: the "bracket screen" archetype from doc/getting-started/lcars-design.md.
# A top and a bottom bar (short sweeps continued as labelled segments) with the title, a sidebar of blocks with code numbers, a
# cutaway display, a side readout list and a row of pills under the display. The view
# uses the LCARS Zeldaar theme for a DS9 palette; every colour is a theme role.
# Uses lcards_test_* helpers.
title: DS9 Bracket
views:
  - title: Runabout
    path: runabout
    theme: LCARS Zeldaar
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 8px
      grid-template-columns: 150px 110px minmax(0, 3fr) minmax(0, 1fr)
      grid-template-rows: 70px minmax(0, 1fr) 64px 70px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "tcorner tcorner tbar    tbar"
        "side    display display list"
        "side    pills   pills   list"
        "bcorner bcorner bbar    bbar"
    cards:
      # Top bar: a short sweep continued as segments, the title under them.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: tcorner
        elbow:
          type: header-left
          segment:
            bar_width: 150
            bar_height: 26
            color: theme:colors.ui.primary
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: tbar
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: 4fr 1fr 2fr 1fr
          grid-template-rows: 26px minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-areas: |
            "s1 s2 s3 s4"
            ". title title title"
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 26, view_layout: { grid-area: s1 }, text: { label: { content: "FEDERATION/CARDASSIAN BORDER", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 26, view_layout: { grid-area: s2 }, text: { label: { content: "78", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 26, view_layout: { grid-area: s3 }, text: { label: { content: "BAJOR SECTOR", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 26, view_layout: { grid-area: s4 }, text: { label: { content: "2369", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            view_layout: { grid-area: title }
            preset: text-only
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: "SHUTTLECRAFT SYSTEMS • 3645", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 30, color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } }

      # Sidebar: blocks of different heights in different roles, each with a code.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: side
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-rows: 1fr 2fr 1fr 1fr 3fr
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: 848-5094 } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: 374-8463 } }
            style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights
            text: { label: { content: 348-4636 } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: 754-9473 } }
            style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: 758-5094 } } }

      # The display: the shuttle cutaway, in colour.
      - type: custom:lcards-msd-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: display
        msd:
          base_svg:
            source: builtin:enterprise-d-shuttlecraft15-anomaly
          view_box: [-20, -20, 1083, 499]

      # Readout list beside the display.
      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        view_layout:
          grid-area: list
        data_mode: data
        rows:
          - values: [SYSTEM, STATUS]
            header: true
          - [IMPULSE, "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_power') | int }} %"]
          - [SHIELDS, "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_shields') | int }} %"]
          - [CABIN, "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_temperature') }} C"]
          - [HUMIDITY, "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_humidity') | int }} %"]
          - [LIGHTS, "{{ states('input_boolean.lcards_test_lights') | upper }}"]
          - [HATCH, "{{ 'OPEN' if is_state('input_boolean.lcards_test_doors', 'on') else 'SEALED' }}"]
        grid:
          grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr
          grid-template-rows: repeat(7, min-content)
          gap: 8px
        style:
          font_size: 20px
        columns:
          - style:
              align: left
              color: theme:colors.ui.secondary
          - style:
              align: right
              color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary

      # Pills under the display, in two roles.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: pills
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr))
          grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr)
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: lozenge
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors
            text: { label: { content: HATCH, show: true } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: lozenge
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_toggle
            text: { label: { content: SHIELDS, show: true } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: 21-7745, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: 40-2274, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: 68-5009, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }

      # Bottom bar: the same, mirrored.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: bcorner
        elbow:
          type: footer-left
          segment:
            bar_width: 150
            bar_height: 26
            color: theme:colors.ui.primary
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: bbar
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 4fr 1fr
          grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) 26px
          grid-template-areas: |
            ". . . sub"
            "s1 s2 s3 s4"
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            view_layout: { grid-area: sub }
            preset: text-only
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: "73647-8947", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 22, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 26, view_layout: { grid-area: s1 }, text: { label: { content: "UNIT 15", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 26, view_layout: { grid-area: s2 }, text: { label: { content: "47", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 26, view_layout: { grid-area: s3 }, text: { label: { content: "BOUNDARIES PRIOR TO HOSTILITIES", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 26, view_layout: { grid-area: s4 }, text: { label: { content: "4747", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }

Classic: list ​

Voyager-style: a split header whose two bars continue as segments, a number cascade, a duty roster list, a column of big numbers and pill groups. The view uses theme: LCARS Nemesis Blue.

YAML
yaml
# Voyager roster: the "list" archetype from doc/getting-started/lcars-design.md. A split
# header (an upper block sweeping down into a bar, a lower one sweeping out of the next),
# a number cascade in the header, a roster list, a column of big numbers and a row of
# pill groups. The view uses the LCARS Nemesis Blue theme; every colour is a theme role.
# Uses lcards_test_* helpers.
title: Voyager Roster
views:
  - title: Roster
    path: roster
    theme: LCARS Nemesis Blue
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 8px
      grid-template-columns: 160px 100px minmax(0, 1fr) 260px
      grid-template-rows: 150px 50px minmax(0, 1fr) 70px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "ucorner ucorner upper   cascade"
        "lcorner lcorner lower   lower"
        "side    list    list    numbers"
        "pills   pills   pills   pills"
    cards:
      # Split header: the upper block sweeps down into a bar continued as segments...
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: ucorner
        elbow:
          type: footer-left
          segment:
            bar_width: 160
            bar_height: 20
            color: theme:colors.ui.secondary
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: upper
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: 3fr 1fr 2fr
          grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) 20px
          grid-template-areas: |
            "title title title"
            "s1 s2 s3"
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            view_layout: { grid-area: title }
            preset: text-only
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: "VOYAGER DUTY ROSTER · 12.25.95", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 32, color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 20, view_layout: { grid-area: s1 }, text: { label: { content: "CREW ASSIGNMENTS", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 20, view_layout: { grid-area: s2 }, text: { label: { content: "47", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 20, view_layout: { grid-area: s3 }, text: { label: { content: "DECK 5", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }

      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        view_layout:
          grid-area: cascade
        data_mode: decorative
        format: digit
        grid:
          grid-template-rows: repeat(5, auto)
          grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))
          gap: 0px
        style:
          padding: 0px
          font_size: 18px
        animations:
          - trigger: on_load
            preset: cascade-color
      # ...and the lower one sweeps out of the next, also continued as segments.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: lcorner
        elbow:
          type: header-left
          segment:
            bar_width: 160
            bar_height: 20
            color: theme:colors.ui.primary
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: lower
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: 1fr 4fr 1fr 2fr
          grid-template-rows: 20px
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 20, text: { label: { content: "02-262000", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 20, text: { label: { content: "OPTICAL DATA NETWORK AVAILABLE", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 20, text: { label: { content: "12", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 20, text: { label: { content: "03-111968", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }

      # Sidebar under the lower sweep.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: side
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-rows: 2fr 1fr 1fr
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: 03-111968 } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: 04-041969 } }
            style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: 05-1701D } }
            style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } }

      # The roster.
      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        view_layout:
          grid-area: list
        data_mode: data
        rows:
          - values: [Name, Station, Shift, Status]
            header: true
          - [TUVOK, SECURITY, ALPHA, ON DUTY]
          - [TORRES, ENGINEERING, BETA, ON DUTY]
          - [PARIS, CONN, ALPHA, ON DUTY]
          - [KIM, OPERATIONS, GAMMA, OFF DUTY]
          - [NEELIX, GALLEY, ALPHA, ON DUTY]
          - [SEVEN, ASTROMETRICS, BETA, OFF DUTY]
          - [DOCTOR, SICKBAY, ALL, ACTIVE]
          - [CHAKOTAY, COMMAND, ALPHA, ON DUTY]
        grid:
          grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1.4fr 0.8fr 1fr
          grid-template-rows: repeat(9, min-content)
          gap: 6px
        style:
          font_size: 20px
        columns:
          - style:
              align: left
              color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary
          - style:
              align: left
              color: theme:colors.ui.primary
          - style:
              align: left
              color: theme:colors.ui.secondary
          - style:
              align: right
              color: theme:colors.ui.primary

      # A column of big numbers.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: numbers
        layout:
          grid-gap: 4px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-rows: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: "752", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 54, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: "77", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 54, color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: "04", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 54, color: theme:colors.ui.primary } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: "003", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 54, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } }

      # Pill groups along the bottom.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: pills
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr))
          grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr)
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: lozenge
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights
            text: { label: { content: LIGHTS, show: true } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: lozenge
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors
            text: { label: { content: DOORS, show: true } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: 07 9012, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: 09 4421, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.primary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: 12 6610, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, text: { label: { content: 15 0087, show: true } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.secondary } } } } }
